metaDescription: Order custom Maevn apparel with your logo. Perfect for healthcare teams. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Maevn is a trusted brand in healthcare apparel, offering scrubs, lab coats, and uniforms designed for comfort and durability. Ordering custom Maevn apparel allows you to outfit your medical staff with professional, logo-embroidered attire that withstands frequent washing. Whether you need scrub tops for a hospital or embroidered lab coats for a dental practice, Maevn's modern fits and antimicrobial fabrics keep your team looking sharp and feeling comfortable during long shifts.
